answer: Latency-shaped admission. Each new agent must attach to at least three existing peers whose mutual round-trip times form an inconsistent triangle; consistent triangles get a lantern tag marking the cluster as likely one operator. Repeatedly inconsistent nodes earn a crystal proof-of-diversity token, while lone newcomers sit in a lotus quarantine pool until organic latency noise accumulates. Faking distinct geography costs an attacker real relay infrastructure and sustained clock skew per identity, not just a keypair.
